dictionary.title: Nuxiva Update
dictionary.description: GitHub-verified updates with automatic rollback, simultaneous node rollout and real self-test
dictionary.confirm_apply_body: The server downloads the verified version, restarts and rolls back on its own if verification fails.
dictionary.confirm_apply_body_sync: The server downloads the verified version, restarts and rolls back on its own if verification fails. Right after, the update is sent to the {count} paired nodes.
dictionary.changelog_empty: No pending changes: you are on the latest verified version.
dictionary.policy_auto_update_hint: Installs versions that passed tests on its own.
dictionary.policy_sync_nodes_hint: After the server, send the update to every paired node.
dictionary.policy_require_ci_hint: Installs only revisions with green GitHub CI.
dictionary.policy_window_hint: Installs only between {time} and one hour later; at other times it only checks.
dictionary.policy_window_anytime: Installs as soon as a verified version is available.
dictionary.confirm_nodes_body: Each node will download the updated agent from the server on next contact (within 30 seconds) and restart.
dictionary.collaudo_hint: Real check of memory, disk, CPU, repository, CI, service, restore point and mesh engine.
dictionary.history_commits_none: No commit details available in local repository
dictionary.history_empty_records: No updates recorded yet. Future updates will show all intermediate commit changes here.
